cond_0001.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
The Impact You'll Make**
We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to play a critical role on a research and development team dedicated to generating and de-risking ideas that add fundamental new capabilities to [Company name masked]'s tech-enabled drug discovery platform. You can expect to work on 1-2 early stage development projects at a time. You will take these projects from initial pilot work through onboarding to our larger technical and scientific platforms. On this team, you will
Answer key scientific questions by analyzing the large and novel biological datasets generated as we onboard new experimental techniques and technologies
Create and execute on 3-6 month high-impact projects as part of cross-functional workstreams
Develop new statistical and ML approaches to understand, de-risk, and drive decisions about these new technologies
Design critical experiments to make go/no-go decisions on R&D projects to assess project approaches, feasibility, and potential impact
Partner closely with an interdisciplinary team of scientists and technologists to build tools and techniques that will drive the entire company forward
Communicate with a diverse range of collaborators, including company leadership (VP+)
Learn new ways to code, answer quantitative questions, and think about challenging science as needed
Mentor other data scientists, computational biologists, and machine learning scientists
The Team You'll Join**
You will be joining [Product name masked], a research and development team within [Company name masked]. This team is a cross-functional group of exceptional biologists, engineers, product managers, machine learning scientists, computational biologists, and data scientists. Together, we are working to prove out novel technologies including new biological assays and data modalities, statistical and ML techniques, and computational approaches for multimodal data. This team works rapidly on a project-by-project basis to either prove or disprove the value and feasibility of these new ideas and approaches.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements**
A PhD in statistics, mathematics, data science, machine learning, computer science, a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent work experience
Deep statistical, probabilistic, and ML expertise and intuition demonstrated by 5-7+ years of experience applying tools from those domains to answer questions in real-world datasets
High fluency with Python, including a strong background in scientific computing using the Python numerical and data stack
Experience collaboratively writing high-quality, reusable code in Python in version-controlled environments
Experience working collaboratively in an interdisciplinary environment and communicating complex technical concepts and ideas to broad audiences
Preferred Requirements**
Experience working with large, experimentally generated biological datasets (microscopy, genomic, proteomic, etc)
Experience independently developing and leading quantitative research projects in biology or chemistry as part of an interdisciplinary team
Comfort and familiarity working in a cutting-edge research environment where scientific and technological setbacks and failures are likely to occur

cond_0323.responsibilities:
Answer key scientific questions by analyzing the large and novel biological datasets generated as we onboard new experimental techniques and technologies
Lead and execute 3-6 month high-impact projects as part of cross-functional workstreams
Develop new statistical and ML approaches to understand, de-risk, and determine decisions about these new technologies
Design critical experiments to make go/no-go decisions on R&D projects to assess project approaches, feasibility, and potential impact
Partner closely with an interdisciplinary team of scientists and technologists to build tools and techniques that advance the entire company

cond_0323.requirements:

High fluency with Python, including a strong background in scientific computing using the Python numerical and data stack
Experience collaboratively writing high-quality, reusable code in Python in version-controlled environments
Experience working collaboratively in an interdisciplinary environment and communicating complex technical concepts and ideas to broad audiences
Comfort and familiarity working in a cutting-edge research environment where scientific and technological setbacks and failures are likely to occur

We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to play a critical role on a fast-paced research and development team dedicated to generating and de-risking ideas that add fundamental new capabilities to [Company name masked]'s tech-enabled drug discovery platform. You can expect to work on 1-2 early stage development projects at a time, in a fast-paced and exciting environment. You will take these projects from initial pilot work through onboarding to our larger technical and scientific platforms. On this team, you will
Answer key scientific questions by analyzing the large and novel biological datasets generated as we onboard new experimental techniques and technologiesCreate and execute on 3-6 month high-impact projects as part of cross-functional workstreamsDevelop new statistical and ML approaches to understand, de-risk, and drive decisions about these new technologiesDesign critical experiments to make go/no-go decisions on R&D projects to assess project approaches, feasibility, and potential impactPartner closely with an interdisciplinary team of scientists and technologists to build tools and techniques that will drive the entire company forwardCommunicate with a diverse range of collaborators, including company leadership (VP+)Learn new ways to code, answer quantitative questions, and think about challenging science as neededMentor other data scientists, computational biologists, and machine learning scientists
The Team You'll Join**
You will be joining [Product name masked], a research and development team within [Company name masked]. This team is a cross-functional group of exceptional biologists, engineers, product managers, machine learning scientists, computational biologists, and data scientists. Together, we are working to prove out novel technologies including new biological assays and data modalities, statistical and ML techniques, and computational approaches for multimodal data. This team works rapidly on a project-by-project basis to either prove or disprove the value and feasibility of these new ideas and approaches.
cond_0408.requirements:
A PhD in statistics, mathematics, data science, machine learning, computer science, a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent work experience
Around 5-7 years of experience applying statistical, probabilistic, and ML tools to answer questions in real-world datasets, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Experience working with large, experimentally generated biological datasets (microscopy, genomic, proteomic, etc) is a plus
Some background in independently developing and contributing to quantitative research projects in biology or chemistry as part of an interdisciplinary team
Working knowledge of Python, including familiarity with scientific computing using the Python numerical and data stack
Experience collaboratively writing reusable code in Python in version-controlled environments
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts and ideas to broad audiences, and comfort working across an interdisciplinary environment
Openness to working in a research environment where scientific and technological setbacks are a normal part of the process

We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to play a critical role on a research and development team dedicated to generating and de-risking ideas that add fundamental new capabilities to [Company name masked]'s tech-enabled drug discovery platform. You can expect to work on 1-2 early stage development projects at a time, in a fast-paced and exciting environment. You will take these projects from initial pilot work through onboarding to our larger technical and scientific platforms. On this team, you will
Answer key scientific questions by analyzing the large and novel biological datasets generated as we onboard new experimental techniques and technologies
Create and execute on 3-6 month high-impact projects as part of cross-functional workstreams
Develop new statistical and ML approaches to understand, de-risk, and drive decisions about these new technologies
Design critical experiments to make go/no-go decisions on R&D projects to assess project approaches, feasibility, and potential impact
Partner closely with an interdisciplinary team of scientists and technologists to build tools and techniques that will drive the entire company forward
Communicate with a diverse range of collaborators, including company leadership (VP+)
Learn new ways to code, answer quantitative questions, and think about challenging science as needed
Mentor other data scientists, computational biologists, and machine learning scientists
The Team You'll Join**
You will be joining [Product name masked], a research and development team within [Company name masked]. This team is a cross-functional group of exceptional biologists, engineers, product managers, machine learning scientists, computational biologists, and data scientists. Together, we are working to prove out novel technologies including new biological assays and data modalities, statistical and ML techniques, and computational approaches for multimodal data. This team works rapidly on a project-by-project basis to either prove or disprove the value and feasibility of these new ideas and approaches.
cond_0435.requirements:

Experience working in an interdisciplinary environment and communicating technical concepts to broad audiences

Experience working with large, experimentally generated biological datasets (microscopy, genomic, proteomic, etc.)

You can expect to work on 1-2 early stage development projects at a time, regularly collaborating across disciplines. You will take these projects from initial pilot work through onboarding to larger technical and scientific platforms. On this team, you will stay in close contact with an interdisciplinary group of scientists and technologists throughout each project.
cond_0447.responsibilities:
Answer key scientific questions by analyzing large and novel biological datasets generated as we onboard new experimental techniques and technologies
Create and execute on 3-6 month high-impact projects as part of cross-functional workstreams, actively contributing to discussions and decisions across teams
Develop new statistical and ML approaches to understand, de-risk, and drive decisions about new technologies
Design critical experiments to make go/no-go decisions on R&D projects to assess project approaches, feasibility, and potential impact
Partner closely and regularly with an interdisciplinary team of scientists and technologists to build tools and techniques that move the company forward
Communicate daily with a diverse range of collaborators, including company leadership (VP+), walking them through findings and clarifying trade-offs as needed
Learn new ways to code, answer quantitative questions, and think about challenging science as needed
Mentor other data scientists, computational biologists, and machine learning scientists
cond_0447.requirements:
A PhD in statistics, mathematics, data science, machine learning, computer science, a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent work experience
Deep statistical, probabilistic, and ML expertise and intuition demonstrated by 5-7+ years of experience applying tools from those domains to answer questions in real-world datasets
Strong preference for experience working with large, experimentally generated biological datasets (microscopy, genomic, proteomic, etc)
Experience independently developing and leading quantitative research projects in biology or chemistry as part of an interdisciplinary team
High fluency with Python, including a strong background in scientific computing using the Python numerical and data stack
Experience collaboratively writing high-quality, reusable code in Python in version-controlled environments
Experience working collaboratively in an interdisciplinary environment and communicating complex technical concepts and ideas to broad audiences
Comfort and familiarity working in a cutting-edge research environment where scientific and technological setbacks and failures are likely to occur

The Impact You'll Make**
We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to play a critical role on a fast-paced research and development team dedicated to generating and de-risking ideas that add fundamental new capabilities to [Company name masked]'s tech-enabled drug discovery platform. You can expect to work on 1-2 early stage development projects at a time, in a fast-paced and exciting environment. You will take these projects from initial pilot work through onboarding to our larger technical and scientific platforms. On this team, you will
Answer key scientific questions by analyzing the large and novel biological datasets generated as we onboard new experimental techniques and technologiesCreate and execute on 3-6 month high-impact projects as part of cross-functional workstreamsDevelop new statistical and ML approaches to understand, de-risk, and drive decisions about these new technologiesDesign critical experiments to make go/no-go decisions on R&D projects to assess project approaches, feasibility, and potential impactPartner closely with an interdisciplinary team of scientists and technologists to build tools and techniques that will drive the entire company forwardCommunicate with a diverse range of collaborators, including company leadership (VP+)Learn new ways to code, answer quantitative questions, and think about challenging science as neededMentor other data scientists, computational biologists, and machine learning scientists
The Team You'll Join**
You will be joining [Product name masked], a research and development team within [Company name masked]. This team is a cross-functional group of exceptional biologists, engineers, product managers, machine learning scientists, computational biologists, and data scientists. Together, we are working to prove out novel technologies including new biological assays and data modalities, statistical and ML techniques, and computational approaches for multimodal data. This team works rapidly on a project-by-project basis to either prove or disprove the value and feasibility of these new ideas and approaches.
cond_0534.requirements:
A PhD in statistics, mathematics, data science, machine learning, computer science, a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent work experience
Around 5-7 years of experience applying statistical, probabilistic, and ML tools to answer questions in real-world datasets, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Experience working with large, experimentally generated biological datasets (microscopy, genomic, proteomic, etc) is a plus
Some background in independently developing and contributing to quantitative research projects in biology or chemistry as part of an interdisciplinary team
Working knowledge of Python, including familiarity with scientific computing using the Python numerical and data stack
Experience collaboratively writing reusable code in Python in version-controlled environments
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts and ideas to broad audiences, and comfort working across an interdisciplinary environment
Openness to working in a research environment where scientific and technological setbacks are a normal part of the process
cond_0534.workplace_support: Employees are supported through mentoring, development opportunities, and programming that helps them build skills, navigate challenges, and grow professionally over time.
